parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC).

parameters.name: ObjectPath
parameters.description: The path used to query. Exact match is used.

parameters.name: ObjectType
parameters.description:
The task type. Valid values:
- **file**: file purge.
- **directory**: directory purge.
- **preload**: file prefetch.

> When DomainName or Status is specified, ObjectType is required.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: **20**. Maximum value: **50**.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC). > Only data within the last 3 days can be queried.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The task status. Valid values:

- **Complete**: completed.
- **Refreshing**: in progress.
- **Failed**: failed.

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description: The task ID used to query the purge status.
